The first public release of **ByteExplorer**: a fast, beautiful file explorer for Windows and Linux.

## Download

| System | File | How to start |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows 10/11 (64-bit)** | `ByteExplorer-1.0.0-win-x64.zip` | Unzip it anywhere and run `ByteExplorer.exe`. |
| **Linux (64-bit)** | `ByteExplorer-1.0.0-linux-x64.tar.gz` | `tar -xzf ByteExplorer-1.0.0-linux-x64.tar.gz`, then `./ByteExplorer-1.0.0-linux-x64/ByteExplorer` |

Nothing else to install: .NET is included in both.

- **Windows:** the program isn't code-signed yet, so the first start may show *"Windows protected your PC"*. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. Video and music previews (VLC) are included.
- **Linux:** for video and music previews install VLC from your distribution (`sudo apt install vlc`, not the Flatpak or Snap); see the [README](https://github.com/Eliquin/ByteExplorer-public#video-and-music-previews-vlc).
- **macOS:** no build yet; it can be built from source.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` checks the downloads. `vlc-3.0.21.tar.xz` is VLC's source code, published because the Windows build includes VLC (LGPL/GPL); you don't need it.

ByteExplorer never connects to the internet on its own and never updates itself: new versions are published here.

## Highlights

- Tabs, split view, new windows; Details, List, Tiles, Icons, Columns, Timeline and Nexus views
- Instant search across your drives, with filters and search inside documents
- Tags, Lens smart views with a time river, bulk rename, password-protected items
- A copy queue with pause, verified copies, crash recovery, and undo/redo for almost everything
- Three layouts (Modern, Trove, Folio), five left-panel designs, themes, colours and fonts
